releaseScope: Architecture 3.x repair round R-P5 (D-90): session open accepts attachPid - the connector verifies the pid through the platform liveness provider, marks the record attached (never launched), and refuses ATTACH_FAILED/SOFTWARE_CALL_FAILED when the pid is gone instead of starting a replacement. No new error code; no other behavior changes.
changes: check_envelope: an absent `kind` is treated as a request (the shape the engine actually sends); an explicit wrong value is still refused. No other loosening: required keys per shape, the 64-hex idempotency key and the closed call key set are all still enforced.
unchanged: connector.py apart from that one guard; the session lifecycle, credential materialization, refusal redaction, attestation, locks, idempotency and artifacts
howItShouldHaveBeenCaught: the P7 smoke built its own messages and always included `kind`, so it proved the author's shape rather than the engine's. Two cells in the P3 battery now send the engine's exact message forms.
openDeferred: D-86/D-93 remain: the engine emits messages the published request schemas forbid. The connector interoperates instead of breaking the engine; the contract generation owns the fix.

D-94: architecture-ops 1.4.0's matrix turns an UNCLASSIFIED gateway error into PASS, contradicting its own comment - which is why the broken inventory answered PASS 6 while health said three recipes are not dispatchable.
pointerPolicy: software/_connector/current.json moves 1.0.5 -> 1.0.6; qoder production resolves through that pointer, so the binding is retargeted by the same script that made it.
